title_sq: Tek Liqeni Tiranes, Lake View Residence ,Shitet Apartament 2+1, Me Super Pamje Dhe Orientim Perfekt!
description_sq: Tek Liqeni i Tiranes, ne Rezidencen Lake View, shitet super apartament 2+1+2, me pamje te mrekullueshme nga Liqeni. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 13 te njeres prej godinave te kompleksit, i cili karakterizohet nga nje cilesi superiore ne te gjithe aspektet e ndertimit. Strukturohet ne nje sallon teper te bollshem ndenje me pamje spektakolare dhe i rrethuar nga veranda, dy dhoma gjumi, dy tualete dhe veranda. Orientohet totalisht nga jug-perendimi element qe e ben te ndricuar dhe te ngrohte ne menyre natyrale edhe pse cilesia e izolimit eshte superiore e rrethuar me vetrata super triplex. Zona eshte elementi kryesor qe i jep vleren me te madhe kesaj prone, vetem 50 m ne vije ajrore me liqenin dhe parkun e tij. Gjithcka persa i perket investimit te ngurte perfshihet ne cmim, materiale te nje cilesie shume te larte, parketi, hidrosanitaret, vetratat etj. Ne funksion te ketij apartamenti eshte dhe nje post parkimi me cmim ekstra prej 22,000 eurosh.
title_en: At Tiranes Lake, Lake View Residence, 2+1 Apartment For Sale, With Great View And Perfect Orientation!
description_en: At the Lake of Tirana, in the Lake View Residence, a super apartment 2+1+2, with a wonderful view of the Lake, is for sale. The apartment is located on the 13th floor of one of the buildings of the complex, which is characterized by superior quality in all aspects of construction. It is structured in a very spacious living room with a spectacular view and surrounded by a veranda, two bedrooms, two toilets and a veranda. It is completely oriented to the south-west, an element that makes it bright and warm in a natural way, even though the quality of the insulation is superior, surrounded by super triplex windows. The area is the main element that gives the greatest value to this property, only 50 m as the crow flies with the lake and its park. Everything regarding the solid investment is included in the price, materials of a very high quality, parquet, hydrosanitary, windows, etc. In addition to this apartment, there is also a parking post with an extra price of 22,000 euros.
